cases.translation: Such was the portion of the tribe of Manasseh.
cases.explain: The possessive construction 'the portion of the tribe' uses the genitive case.

cases.translation: The lands extended to the sea.
cases.explain: The preposition до (up to) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: Their boundary went to the land.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) with motion verbs takes the accusative case.
The preposition на (to) with the verb 'came' takes the accusative case.

cases.translation: In the land strength was with Israel.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: The land of Judah was too large for them.
cases.explain: The possessive construction uses the genitive case.

cases.translation: The sons of Israel attacked the Canaanites.
cases.explain: The possessive construction 'sons of Israel' uses the genitive case.

cases.translation: The descendants of Joseph spoke to Joshua.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

reading.ru: Таким был надел рода Монассии, как первенца Иосифа.
reading.question: What was the inheritance of Manasseh like?
options: Like the portion of the firstborn of Joseph
Like the portion of the priesthood
Like the portion of the wilderness
reading.correct: Like the portion of the firstborn of Joseph
reading.explain: The text states надел рода Монассии, как первенца Иосифа (the portion of the tribe of Manasseh, like the firstborn of Joseph).

reading.ru: Махиру, первенцу Монассии, предку Галаадитян, были выделены Галаад и Башан, потому что Махириты были храбрыми воинами.
reading.question: Why were Gilead and Bashan given to Machir?
options: Because the Makirites were brave warriors
Because they were the most fertile lands
Because Machir was the high priest
reading.correct: Because the Makirites were brave warriors
reading.explain: The text states были выделены Галаад и Башан, потому что Махириты были храбрыми воинами (Gilead and Bashan were given because the Makirites were brave warriors).

reading.ru: У Целовхада, сына Хефера, сына Галаада, сына Махира, сына Монасии, не было сыновей, а были только дочери.
reading.question: What did Zelophehad have instead of sons?
reading.explain: The text clearly states не было сыновей, а были только дочери (had no sons, but had only daughters).

reading.ru: Они пришли к священнику Илиазару и Иисусу, сыну Навину, и вождям, и сказали, Господь повелел Моисею дать нам удел между нашими братьями.
reading.question: What did Zelophehad's daughters ask for?
reading.explain: The text states они сказали... Господь повелел Моисею дать нам удел между нашими братьями (they said... the Lord commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers).

reading.ru: Но когда израилетяне окрепли, они подчинили себе хананеев, хотя не изгнали их полностью.
reading.question: What did the Israelites do to the Canaanites when they became strong?
options: They enslaved them and made them do forced labor, but did not drive them out completely
reading.correct: They enslaved them and made them do forced labor, but did not drive them out completely
reading.explain: The text states они подчинили себе хананеев, хотя не изгнали их полностью (they enslaved the Canaanites, although they did not drive them out completely).

reading.ru: Потомки Иосифа сказали Иисусу, «Почему ты дал нам в удел только один надел и один участок?»
reading.question: What complaint did Joseph's descendants make to Joshua?
options: Why did you give us only one portion and one territory?
Why did you give us too much land?
Why did you not include the Canaanites?
Why did you give the best land to Judah?
reading.correct: Why did you give us only one portion and one territory?
reading.explain: The text records their direct question Почему ты дал нам в удел только один надел и один участок? (Why have you given us only one lot and one part for an inheritance?).
